dataset_name: Live confidential document QA — LLM judge pilot
ground_truth_note: Expected facts are transcribed from four real university documents after authorized application-layer decryption and successful integrity verification. The dataset contains factual evaluation targets only; it does not contain document plaintext or generated model answers.
scoring_note: The current evaluator uses lexical substring matching. This can measure the presence of expected terms but cannot reliably verify relationships between fields (for example, whether a grade and credit value belong to the correct course). Multi-fact and list questions should therefore be interpreted with this limitation in mind. Cross-document questions are intentionally excluded because the current single-document evaluation workflow has not yet been confirmed to retrieve multiple documents for one question.
